info.name: Aali Market API
info.description:
Price-first mobile shopping API for small-town India. All money is integer paise. Bilingual fields are { en, hi }. Every response is { success, data, error }.

Flow to try this collection end to end:
1. Auth > Send OTP, check the server console for the printed code (SMS_PROVIDER=console in dev), then Auth > Verify OTP (auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken).
2. Catalog > List Categories / List Products (auto-saves categoryId/productId/productSlug).
3. Cart > Add Item, Apply Coupon (code AALI50, needs subtotal >= ₹199).
4. Addresses > Create Address (auto-saves addressId).
5. Orders > Create Order (auto-saves orderId) — Idempotency-Key header uses the {{$guid}} dynamic variable, so re-sending the exact same request body+key replays the same order.
6. Admin folder uses its own adminAccessToken — Send/Verify OTP with the seeded admin mobile (9999999999 by default).

New in this version: Catalog > Suggest Products / Store Settings, Orders > Create Order (UPI), Payments > Verify Payment, and Admin > Dashboard, Orders, Settings, Pincodes, plus inactive-inclusive product/category/banner lists.

Also in this version: Orders > Pay Again / Switch Payment to COD / Reorder, Push (PWA), Rider (login + deliver with OTP), and Admin > Riders, Reports, Reviews, bulk/CSV product tools, Assign Rider, Latest Orders, Update Store Info.

request.description: Rate-limited to 3 sends / 15 min / mobile. In dev (SMS_PROVIDER=console) the code is printed to the server console, not sent via SMS.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken for user', json.data.user && json.data.user.mobile);

request.description: Set collection variable {{otpCode}} to the value printed in the server console before sending. Creates the user on first verify. Auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken.
deliveryFee, freeDeliveryThreshold, handlingFee, minOrderValue (paise), storeOpen, storeTimings. Use for "add ₹X more for free delivery".
sort: popular | price_asc | price_desc | newest | discount
Prefix search, top 8: { id, slug, title, price, image }. "att" finds "atta" (a tag) — $text could not.
Requires the user to have a DELIVERED order containing this product — otherwise returns REVIEW_REQUIRES_DELIVERED_ORDER.
Optional ?pincode= previews that area's delivery-fee override so the total matches checkout.
qty: 0 removes the item

AALI50 needs a subtotal of at least ₹199 (19900 paise). Errors: COUPON_NOT_FOUND, COUPON_INACTIVE, COUPON_EXPIRED, COUPON_NOT_STARTED, COUPON_MIN_ORDER, COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, COUPON_PER_USER_LIMIT_REACHED, CART_EMPTY.

body.raw: {"label":"Home","line1":"123 MG Road","line2":"Near Bus Stand","landmark":"Opposite Petrol Pump","city":"Sitapur","state":"Uttar Pradesh","pincode":"261001","isDefault":true,"location":{"lat":27.5706,"lng":80.6822}}

request.description: location {lat, lng} is optional (both values or none) — it helps the rider find the house and is copied into the order's shippingAddress. On PATCH, send "location": null to clear it.

header.description: Re-sending the same key + body replays the original order instead of creating a duplicate.

body.raw: {"addressId":"{{addressId}}","paymentMethod":"cod","deliveryNote":"Ring the bell twice, leave with the guard"}

request.description:
paymentMethod: cod | upi | card | netbanking. Re-validates stock/price/coupon and decrements stock inside a transaction.

deliveryNote (optional, max 200 chars) is shown to the rider. The response includes `deliveryOtp` — the 4-digit code the customer reads out to the rider (saved to {{deliveryOtp}} by the test script).

body.raw: {"addressId":"{{addressId}}","paymentMethod":"upi","deliveryNote":"Ring the bell twice, leave with the guard"}

request.description:
Response includes data.payment = { provider, keyId, providerOrderId, amount, currency }. Open Razorpay checkout with keyId + providerOrderId, then call Payments > Verify Payment. Can also fail with STORE_CLOSED (503), MIN_ORDER_VALUE, NOT_SERVICEABLE.

deliveryNote (optional, max 200 chars) is shown to the rider. The response includes `deliveryOtp` — the 4-digit code the customer reads out to the rider (saved to {{deliveryOtp}} by the test script).
Includes statusHistory for the tracking screen.
Only while status is placed/confirmed/packed — otherwise ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE.
For an unpaid, non-cancelled upi/card/netbanking order. Returns { payment: { provider, keyId, providerOrderId, amount, currency } } for a FRESH gateway order. 400 PAYMENT_NOT_RETRYABLE otherwise.
Only while the online payment is pending/failed. 400 PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_CHANGEABLE otherwise.
Adds the order's items to your cart at today's prices, capped by stock. Response: { cart, skipped: [{ productId, title, reason: inactive | out_of_stock | qty_reduced, requested, added }] }.

Send the three values Razorpay checkout returns (razorpay_order_id is optional). With PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock (non-production) any non-empty signature passes; with razorpay the signature must be HMAC-SHA256("<order_id>|<payment_id>", key secret). Idempotent.

header.description: mock provider accepts any non-empty signature; razorpay provider verifies HMAC-SHA256 against RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET

request.description: Set orderId to the paymentProviderOrderId returned on an order placed with a non-COD paymentMethod. Body is read as raw bytes server-side for signature verification, then parsed as JSON.
adminMobile defaults to 9999999999 (SEED_ADMIN_MOBILE) — must already exist via `npm run seed`.
Set {{adminOtpCode}} from the server console before sending.
isActive=false lists soft-deleted products; re-activate with PATCH { "isActive": true }. lowStock = stock <= LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD.

body.raw: {"title":{"en":"Test Rice 1kg","hi":"टेस्ट चावल 1 किलो"},"slug":"test-rice-1kg","description":{"en":"Premium test rice, 1 kg pack.","hi":"प्रीमियम टेस्ट चावल, 1 किलो पैक।"},"category":"{{categoryId}}","brand":"Aali","images":[],"mrp":9900,"price":8500,"unit":"1 kg","stock":100,"tags":["rice","staple"],"isActive":true}

request.description: mrp/price are integer paise. category must be a real Category id — run Catalog > List Categories first.
Soft-delete: sets isActive=false.
Max 200 rows: [{ id, price?, mrp?, stock?, isActive? }]. Each row is validated on its own (price <= mrp against the final values); response { updated, failed: [{ id, error }] }.
All products incl. inactive. Columns: id, slug, title_en, title_hi, category_slug, brand, unit, mrp, price, stock, isActive. Money in PAISE. UTF-8 with BOM (Excel-friendly). Use Send and Download.

Multipart field "file" (.csv, max 2 MB, max 2000 rows) in the export format. A row with an id updates that product; otherwise the slug decides. On updates blank cells = unchanged. dryRun=true validates and counts, writes nothing. Response { created, updated, errors: [{ row, error }], dryRun } (header = row 1).
Same as the dry run but writes the valid rows.
Soft-delete: sets isActive=false.
type: flat (value = paise off) | percent (value = whole % , capped by maxDiscount paise).
Soft-delete: sets isActive=false.
Soft-delete: sets isActive=false.
Field name must be "images" (max 6 files, 5 MB each, jpeg/png/webp/avif). Select actual files in the Body tab before sending — Postman collections can't embed binary files.
todayOrders, todayRevenue (paise), pendingOrders (placed/confirmed/packed), outForDelivery, lowStockCount, totalCustomers. "Today" = IST day.
name, mobile, ordersCount, createdAt. q = name or mobile substring.
from/to: YYYY-MM-DD = whole IST day (to is inclusive) or an ISO datetime. q = orderNumber or customer mobile substring. user is populated as { id, name, mobile }.
status: placed | confirmed | packed | shipped | out_for_delivery | delivered | cancelled
riderId null unassigns. 400 ORDER_NOT_ASSIGNABLE for delivered/cancelled orders or an inactive rider. The response never contains deliveryOtp.
Poll every few seconds with the newest createdAt you have seen (exclusive). → { count, orders: [{ id, orderNumber, total, createdAt }] } (newest 10). since must be an ISO datetime with a zone.
All money in paise; send only the fields you want to change. storeOpen=false makes POST /orders return 503 STORE_CLOSED. freeDeliveryThreshold 0 = delivery always free.
Public via GET /settings (legal pages, invoices, contact). address merges field by field; any value can be cleared with "". fssaiNumber = 14 digits, gstin = 15 chars.
deliveryFee null = use the store delivery fee. Note: once ANY pincode exists, only active listed pincodes are serviceable.
Hard delete.
The rider then logs in through the normal OTP flow. 409 MOBILE_ALREADY_REGISTERED if the mobile belongs to anyone.
isActive:false blocks login and stops existing tokens working.
groupBy day | week | month → [{ period, orders, revenue, avgOrderValue }] (paise, IST; cancelled / failed / refunded excluded). Default range: last 30 days.
→ [{ productId, title, qtySold, revenue }]
COD orders delivered that IST day → { totalExpected, totalCollected, byRider: [{ rider, orders, expected, collected }] }. rider null = closed by an admin (no cash figure).

Public. 503 PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED until VAPID keys are set (npm run vapid:generate).
Paste what `JSON.stringify(subscription)` gives in the browser. Only browser vendors' push services are accepted. Max 10 devices per user.
The rider must first be created by an admin (Admin > Riders > Create Rider). Same OTP flow as customers.
Set {{riderOtpCode}} from the server console first. Saves riderAccessToken.
Only orders assigned to me. Includes customer name/mobile, address (+ location), deliveryNote; never the OTP.
From confirmed / packed / shipped.
otp is a STRING (leading zeros). Unpaid COD requires cashCollected (paise) and becomes paid. Wrong OTP: 400 INVALID_DELIVERY_OTP (details.attemptsLeft); after 5 wrong tries 429 DELIVERY_OTP_LOCKED.
